objective_text.T67.01.b: Draw all admitted tag/payload states, establish uint64 sufficiency for two uint32 values, and explain which inactive-member operations are avoided. Compare Rust enum constructors and binding behavior with C aggregate initialization and private-header discipline.

objective_text.T67.01.d: Add an owning text variant with a failing clone callback. Derive copy/drop/rollback and exhaustiveness obligations for every old eliminator; demonstrate which clients fail compilation and which silently preserve a default path.

sets.title: Branded pool handles with checked generations

objective_text.T67.05.a: Separate nominal handle category, pool identity, slot generation and ownership; demonstrate why a C wrapper cannot create a compile-time fresh brand per runtime pool or enforce linear use.
objective_text.T67.05.b: Derive FREE/LIVE/RETIRED transitions and count available slots. Explain why copying a handle is permitted by C yet does not duplicate ownership. Pool objects must remain live at fixed addresses and cannot be reinitialized or reused while handles survive: pointer identity does not prevent ABA across object lifetimes. Compare PhantomData nominal/lifetime roles without claiming equivalent static checks.
objective_text.T67.05.c: Run adt.brands and enumerate short acquire/release/get traces against an independent occupancy/generation model. Kill owner-check omission and generation-check omission independently. Compile a wrong-category handle probe; show that copying or explicitly constructing a valid public representation bypasses any unforgeability claim.
objective_text.T67.05.d: Replace the owner pointer with a nonreused externally assigned pool identity and implement relocation of the pool. Then introduce concurrent get/release: provide a reclamation/lifetime protocol, not just an atomic generation counter.

objective_text.T67.09.a: Distinguish tolerance from permissiveness: an unknown noncritical alternative can be retained exactly, while malformed known alternatives and unknown required semantics must fail.
objective_text.T67.09.b: Define a sum of known-number, known-empty and unknown bytes; retain tag and payload even when semantics are unavailable. State lifetime, disjointness, maximum255payloadbytes and overflow-free size calculation. Compare binary unknown-field preservation with the inspected Protobuf guide and demonstrate a field-wise rebuilding path that loses unknown data.
objective_text.T67.09.c: Run adt.evolution and construct a two-version relay trace. Kill unknown-payload-discard and malformed-known-acceptance mutants. Test all truncation points, trailing bytes, capacity shortages, zero-length unknown payload and borrowed-buffer mutation. Record which operations preserve unknown data and which deliberately reject it.
objective_text.T67.09.d: Add duplicate fields and canonical ordering to an extensible record format. Specify how unknown duplicates participate in signatures and forwarding, and demonstrate why accepting arbitrary unknown fields can violate a higher-level security policy.

sets.title: Zero-copy packet view with precise error sum

objective_text.T67.10.a: Port the supplied census packet-view artifact to C while preserving its admitted wire states, error distinctions and borrowed-payload lifetime; identify guarantees supplied by the C API versus the compared language wrappers.
objective_text.T67.10.b: Derive a state table for every failure stage and prove length-3 subtraction is reached only after header validation. No struct overlay, unaligned integer load, allocation or payload copy is permitted. Compare C tag/error conventions with census C++ variant/expected/span without treating the example as an authoritative language specification.
objective_text.T67.10.c: Run adt.packet and enumerate header/extent/tag combinations against the independent byte parser. Kill trailing-byte acceptance and nonempty-ack acceptance separately. Test all truncations and prior-output preservation, then integrate actual learner io.frame and bytes.cursor artifacts with recorded source identities. Public direct-parser anchors do not establish that integration.
objective_text.T67.10.d: Add segmented zero-copy payloads from a receive ring with wraparound and a retained borrow token. Prove storage cannot be recycled while a consumer holds the packet; compare copying and borrowing under equivalent release/cancellation semantics.
